newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway's DNO buys Unocal Britain.
newsitem.headline: Norway's DNO buys Unocal Britain.

text.p: Det Norske Oljeselskap ASA (DNO) said on Tuesday it had bought the entire issued share capital of Unocal Britain Ltd from Unocal Corp.
The terms of the sale were not disclosed.
Unocal Britain is operator of, and holds a 31.25 percent stake in block 2/5, which includes the Heather oilfield, and of the adjoining block 2/4 in the British sector of the North Sea.
Prior to the purchase, DNO held a 6.25 percent interest in the blocks.
"In terms of this acquisition DNO is satisfied that adequate provision has been made for future decommissioning costs of the Heather platform," the company said in a statement on the Oslo bourse.
The deal is subject to approval from the British regulatory authorities, which is expected within two months, DNO said.
